faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment about?
faq.answer: This is a recruitment notification for the temporary post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) for a WB-DSTBT funded sponsored project sanctioned to Nephrocare India Pvt. Ltd. in joint collaboration with NIT Silchar.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of receiving the filled up application form (soft-copy) is 16.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.E/M.Tech or B.E/B.Tech (with GATE/NET qualifying score) or equivalent qualification with first class in aggregate in relevant electrical science streams or Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 16.10.2026, with relaxations permitted based on experience, qualification, and for SC/ST/OBC/WOMEN/PWD/EWS candidates as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly fellowship for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive an INR 25,000 per month consolidated amount for two years, and INR 30,000 per month as SRF in the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applicants must send the soft copy of the filled application form, C.V., and supporting documents via email to [email protected] and [email protected] with the specified subject line.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The date and mode (online/offline) of the interview will be notified in due course of time through email.
